title: Summoner (PC)
notes: COFF timestamp 1006357788 is 2001-11-21 15:49:48 UTC, a later compile than the March 2001 retail release.
On this install Sum.exe, Summ.exe, and rf.exe are byte-identical.
The import table has WSOCK32, OPENGL32, DDRAW, DINPUT, DSOUND, EAX.DLL, and binkw32. It does not import a DirectPlay DLL.
Multiplayer strings name PXO (pxo.net), the Parallax Online service also used by other Volition games.
Code total is .text VirtualSize. Data total is .rdata VirtualSize plus .data SizeOfRawData plus .rsrc VirtualSize. The .data virtual size is mostly uninitialized storage and is not included.
